senses.definition: present participle and gerund of commit
The act by which something is committed.

quotes.text: This and more I would haue done, but what is past cannot bee recalled, and it is too late to put old omittings to new committings.
quotes.reference: 1624, John Taylor, The Scourge of Basenesse:

quotes.text: Any pedagogue knows that a criticism too often repeated destroys its own purpose. These ever more numerous sallies of our social critics into the old world, these punctual committings to print of all the painful things they learn there […]
